Women's health keyword clusters

Browse every keyword group built from competitor rankings. Filter on the left, click any row to see all of its keywords. Menopause is weighted highest in the priority score.

How to read this page

Priority blends five signals: business relevance (35%), commercial intent (25%), search volume (15%), ranking opportunity (15%) and content gap (10%). Menopause clusters carry the highest relevance weight; other women's-health topics are not capped.

Combined volume adds up every keyword in a cluster. Many of those searches overlap, so treat it as a directional size, not a forecast. The primary keyword's own volume is the safer figure for sizing.

Intent was re-checked from the wording of each query, because Semrush's labels were not reliable. A small "≠" next to a keyword means Semrush labelled it differently.

Keyword roles: each cluster has one primary keyword. Close variants are reworded or reordered versions of another keyword in the same cluster.
